transcript.content:
A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: Let me compare per-service span behavior between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, ROUND(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2) p95_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs, SUM(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) http5xx FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(duration)/1e6,2), ROUND(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2), SUM(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
SELECT 'logs' src, service_name, level, COUNT(*) n FROM abnormal_logs GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3
SELECT service_name, attr_log_template, COUNT(*) n, MIN(message) ex FROM abnormal_logs WHERE level IN ('ERROR','WARN') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT service_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, attr_k8s_pod_name, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) http_err, ROUND(AVG(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, span_name, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN attr_status_code<>'OK' AND attr_status_code<>'UNSET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonok FROM normal_traces WHERE span_name LIKE 'geo%' OR span_name LIKE 'rate%' OR span_name LIKE 'search.Search%' OR span_name LIKE 'reservation%' GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, span_name, COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(duration)/1e6,2), SUM(CASE WHEN attr_status_code<>'OK' AND attr_status_code<>'UNSET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces WHERE span_name LIKE 'geo%' OR span_name LIKE 'rate%' OR span_name LIKE 'search.Search%' OR span_name LIKE 'reservation%' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3,1

input.reflection: Findings: geo pod restarts climb 0->2..6 in abnormal (0 in normal); deployment geo available 1->0; no geo server spans in abnormal; search->geo client spans all Error at ~0.02ms (fast fail); search logs ~600/min 'Failed to get nearby hotels from geo service'; frontend /hotels returns 500 on 461 of 463 requests. Search CPU ramps to 2.8 cores as retries loop, a symptom of the geo failure. Rate/profile/reservation drop in volume only because search no longer reaches them. Root cause: geo pod_failure (crash-looping, equivalent to pod_unavailable). Propagation: geo -> search -> frontend.
